exchanges: hi so my son daniel is getting married in april and im the mom of the groom but somehow im doing alot of the planing
Mother of the groom with a planning role, that's a lot of love on your plate. What are you in charge of?
the rehersal dinner and all the out of town ppl. amara's family is doing the wedding part
That's a clear split. How many out-of-town guests are you looking after?
like 40. alot from my side are coming from california
Then airport pickups and hotels will be the big jobs.
yes my brother bao said he'd bring his minivan and do airport runs all weekend, he's a saint
Having him on call all weekend is a huge help with forty guests.
he really is. for the dinner we booked a peruvian place, amara loves it
Peruvian food for a rehearsal dinner is fun and different. Do they do group menus?
yes a set menu. the groomsmen are daniels college friends mostly
College friends usually make for a lively rehearsal dinner.
his best man nima is vegan so i told the resturant
Good, set menus can usually swap in a plant-based plate.
my husband reza's brother is so excited, he said they can use his tesla as the getaway car, hes had it like a month and wont shut up about it
A brand-new Tesla for the getaway, he'll be proud as anything driving them off.
lol yes. his name is kourosh btw, you'll hear about him alot
Noted. Sounds like Kourosh will be a fun one at the dinner.
my mom is coming from san jose, she's 82 and has bad arthritis in her hands
Worth making sure her table has easy-to-use cutlery and someone close by to help.
my niece thu will sit with her, shes so sweet with her
That's lovely, and it'll make your mom more comfortable.
thu is studying to be a vet, shes always taking care of someone
Caring seems to be her nature, people or animals.
true lol. ok the photographer for the dinner is a guy named luca, he did amaras sisters engagment pics
Having someone the family already trusts is a good choice.
i want a slideshow of daniel growing up, is that cheesy
It's a rehearsal dinner classic for a reason. Keep it to five minutes and it'll land well.
ok 5 min. reza is gonna do a toast, hes nervous
Writing it out and practising a couple of times usually helps the nerves.
omg i said nima was vegan, i was wrong hes vegetarian, he eats cheese and eggs, daniel corrected me
Good to know, that gives the restaurant more options.
yah good. welcome bags for the hotel, what do i put in
Water, local snacks, a schedule for the weekend, and maybe something personal like a small note from the couple.
amara's grandma makes these honey cookies maybe we can put those
Homemade cookies from her grandma would be a sweet family touch.
she lives in lagos so idk if she can make that many
Maybe ask for the recipe instead and have a local bakery make them.
ooh good idea
That way it still carries her name and story.
the hotel coordinator is named grace and she is so organized it makes me feel lazy
A good coordinator makes everyone look organized. Lean on her.
she used to run events at a huge hotel in vancouver so nothing scares her
Years of big Vancouver events would have shown her every kind of wedding drama.
and she said shuttles to the venue are free which is nice, bao wont have to do everything
That takes a load off him, especially on the wedding day itself.
ok im gonna go sleep, my brain is mush
Rest well. You covered a lot tonight.

whats nimas diet thing again, i need to tell the resturant
my moms the one with arthritis right
where did grace work before this
ugh i still have to find shoes that dont kill my feet
